assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire does not contain any question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other activities or without care being their main activity. Care for household members is only mentioned as a reason for not being available or desiring to work more hours (Question 29a) or as a status category for inactive persons ("Ama de casa" in Question 36). As the indicator definition explicitly specifies that care given as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count, the proposition is false.
